info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Information Provider Operation By Param1-spec
info.description: The Information Provider Operations API allows users to access operational data for information providers based on specific parameters. This endpoint retrieves detailed information relevant to operational actions, facilitating informed decision-making for financial services. Typical consumers include data analysts, financial institutions, and application developers seeking to integrate operational insights into their systems. Enhanced understanding of market dynamics and provider capabilities can be achieved through this endpoint, contributing to more strategic planning and execution.

get.summary: Retrieve operational actions for the specified information provider.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the operational actions associated with the specified resource (RES-100045) in the market data information provider system. It provides detailed insights into the state and actions of the operational resources.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to retrieve operational actions for the specified information provider. It includes necessary parameters to fetch the relevant market data based on the operational action ID.
